text:
Nina: opened PR to refresh model card for zephyr-aurora v1.2 — primary items: add hybrid-quant notes, per-variant limits, migration guide, and Ruby/PHP SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4285 Can folks eyeball the code samples and the compatibility link? cc @Omar @Leah :eyes:
Omar: on it. Quick heads up: runtime wants `quantize_profile` as a string and supports `hybrid-int8` as a profile name (useful for mixed precision workloads).
Leah: good to call out hybrid quant's tradeoffs. Suggest a short FAQ entry: when to prefer hybrid-int8 vs full fp16 and an example latency/quality table.
Nina: adding an FAQ bullet. Also found the model-card template has an outdated anchor to /docs/compatibility#old-matrix  — Docs Bot flagged it earlier. Will replace with /docs/compatibility/matrix and add a redirect note.
Docs Bot: Template scan: stale anchor found `#old-matrix`. Recommend updating to `/docs/compatibility/matrix#model-routing`.
Omar: SDK snippets: propose these (Ruby + PHP):
```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: 'zephyr-aurora-v1.2-hybrid-int8', input: 'Summarize...', options: { 'quantize_profile' => 'hybrid-int8', 'max_tokens' => 128 })
puts resp.text
```
```php
$client = new \Redwood\Client(getenv('RW_KEY'));
$res = $client->generate([ 'model' => 'zephyr-aurora-v1.2-hybrid-int8', 'input' => '...', 'options' => ['quantize_profile' => 'hybrid-int8', 'max_tokens' => 128] ]);
echo $res->text;
```
Leah: looks good. Add a short note under "Known regressions" that hybrid-int8 can show slight token-level quality drift on repetitive generation patterns beyond 3k context. We'll mark that section DRAFT until bench CSV is uploaded.
Nina: will add DRAFT and a small table showing p50 for 512/2048/4096 once bench numbers land. Also adding a migration example showing how to switch model name and options.
Omar: small nit on the limits table: please include a column for "hosted default" and "dedicated default" so customers know which variant they see by default.
Nina: good idea. I'll add that.
Preview Bot: preview available for PR #4285: https://deploy-previews.internal.redwood/4285 (staging) :white_check_mark:
Leah: one more thing: add a tiny troubleshooting snippet for the common error `invalid option: quantize` — show correct shape and mention `npm run docs:lint` before merge.
Docs Bot: Lint check: missing language markers for the PHP block and a broken internal link to /docs/old-guides.
Nina: fixed language markers, updated link, and pushed. Leaving the bench table as DRAFT until Leah/Omar upload the CSV. Will merge when CI is green and bench CSV is attached. Thanks! :thumbsup:
